import json,os
d1i=[[0]*16 for _ in range(29)]
for r in range(23,26):
    for c in range(9,16): d1i[r][c]=1
for c in range(16): d1i[9][c]=2
d1o=[row[:] for row in d1i]
for r in range(23,26):
    for c in range(9,16): d1o[r][c]=0
for r in range(10,13):
    for c in range(9,16): d1o[r][c]=1
for c in range(16): d1o[13][c]=8
d2i=[[2]*6,
[1,1,0,1,1,1],[1,1,0,0,1,1]]+[[1]*6 for _ in range(7)]
d2o=[row[:] for row in d2i]; d2o[3]=[8]*6
demos=[(d1i,d1o),(d2i,d2o)]

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    ax=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    assert len(ax)==1; ax=ax[0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    if not cells: return g
    bg=g[0][0] if g[0][0]!=2 else next(x for x in g[ax-1] if x!=2)
    col=set(g[r][c] for r,c in cells); obj=col.pop()
    rows=sorted(set(r for r,_ in cells)); cols=sorted(set(c for _,c in cells))
    # clear object
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=0
    side = -1 if rows[0]<ax else 1
    # slide toward axis until adjacent
    top,bottom=rows[0],rows[-1]
    if side==-1:
        newbottom=ax-1; shift=newbottom-bottom
    else:
        newtop=ax+1; shift=newtop-top
    for r,c in cells: g[r+shift][c]=obj
    nrows=[r+shift for r,_ in cells]
    # 8-row full width just beyond object, away from axis
    if side==-1: r8=min(nrows)-1
    else: r8=max(nrows)+1
    g[r8]=[8]*w
    return g

for i,(a,b) in enumerate(demos):
    print(i, transform(a)==b)
t=[[1]*27 for _ in range(9)]
for c in range(16,21): t[1][c]=3
for c in range(27): t[4][c]=2
out=transform(t)
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(out))
